description:
Maven/Java Modules wrapper activating Knock (MicroProfile Health 4.0) in a vidocq deployment.
        The integration relies on knock-cdi-vauban's CDI integration (discovery of
        @Liveness/@Readiness/@Startup) and the JAX-RS @Path scanning of CassiniExtension, which auto-mounts
        KnockHealthResource (@Path("/health")). Its one Java class, KnockHealthExtension, only reads the
        registry for the startup report and the health panel of the dev console. See docs/adr/ADR-002 in the
        knock repo.
